messages:
camille: Quick copy check 14 session restore modal when a user's session expires during a long-running eval. We want calm, clear, and actionable copy. Options below.

devon: Short and helpful. Users should know what's lost vs what they can recover.

sam: Also mention whether running jobs will keep running server-side or be cancelled. Ops team needs clarity.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: button labels should be descriptive and avoid bare verbs. Screen reader note: put the primary action first in the DOM order.

camille: Draft A (reassuring):
```
Session expired
Your session ended while the eval was running. The job will continue running on the server. Sign in to view live progress or reconnect to see results when it finishes.
[Sign in to reconnect] [Dismiss]
```

camille: Draft B (explicit about recoverability):
```
Session expired during an eval
The eval will keep running on our servers for up to 12 hours. Sign in to reconnect and see updates or download partial results.
[Reconnect and view] [Dismiss]
```

devon: I prefer B but "download partial results" might be confusing if we don't provide partials. Ops: can we confirm? @sam

sam: Confirmed: we persist intermediate checkpoints for long evals, but not for all jobs. Better to say "view available results" instead of "download partial results".

camille: OK tweak:
```
Session expired during an eval
The eval will keep running on our servers for up to 12 hours. Sign in to reconnect and view available results and progress.
[Reconnect and view] [Dismiss]
```

accessibility-bot: Button labels look good. For keyboard users, ensure the primary button is focused first and aria-live updates announce reconnect status.

lia: Microcopy nit: change "up to 12 hours" -> "for a limited time" in top-tier copy? But ops care about explicit numbers. I'd keep the 12 hours.

devon: Also add a tiny link "Help: how session persistence works" in the modal for curious users.

camille: Final candidate:
```
Session expired during an eval
The eval will continue running on our servers for up to 12 hours. Sign in to reconnect and view available results and progress.
[Reconnect and view]  Help: how session persistence works  [Dismiss]
```

sam: Great. I'll add a backend flag so modal only shows when persistence is available. Lia/Accessibility please QA once in staging.

lia: Will do NVDA and VoiceOver checks. :ok_hand:

camille: Thanks everyone 611 I'll update Figma and the component docs and tag design QA. Closing unless objections.
